subject: Scheduling dedicated capacity sizing call — Redwood + FintechCo
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@fintechco.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 17:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + next steps from discovery call

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time today — I appreciated the walkthrough of your ingestion pipeline and the expected usage patterns. To recap the parts that matter for sizing:

- Peak concurrent user sessions: ~120
- Typical request size: 300-600 tokens per user (prompt + history)
- Target 95th pct latency SLO: <= 300ms for production traffic
- Expected production QPS (token-level): ~6000 tokens/sec sustained, with spikes up to ~12k tokens/sec during peak batch processing

Next step: we recommend a dedicated capacity sizing call with one of our Solutions Engineers to run through throughput/latency tradeoffs, batching and KV cache strategy, and to align on test harnesses. Camila (cc'd) will lead the session.

Could you share two 60-min windows that work for your infra/ML/eng leads in the next 7 business days? We typically run these as a 45-min technical deep dive + 15-min time for follow-up items. I've attached a quick sizing worksheet and our Dedicated product one-pager for background.

Attachments: fintechco_dedicated_sizing_worksheet.xlsx, redwood_dedicated_productonepager.pdf

Appreciate it — once you confirm a time we'll send a calendar invite and a short pre-read with the test script and sample telemetry we ask you to bring.

Best,

Marissa Cole

- Thursday 2026-03-05 10:00-11:00 PT
- Friday 2026-03-06 14:00-15:00 PT

Our infra lead (Priya N.) and ML engineer (Ben C.) will join — they want to understand how batching and KV caching will affect both latency and cost, and whether Redwood can meet the 300ms 95th percentile under the 12k token/sec spike.

I can also share a link to a small anonymized dataset and request traces ahead of the call if that helps.
